alex_prod: :loudspeaker: FYI — rolling out updated observability & telemetry defaults for Private/VPC deployments. Effective 2026-06-01. Docs: https://go.redwood/onprem-observability
chris_obs: TL;DR bullets we can paste into customer emails?
alex_prod: Sure — short version below.
alex_prod: • Default telemetry: minimal metrics + error aggregates; no request bodies or model outputs collected by default.
alex_prod: • Optional opt-in features: detailed request traces, sample payloads (anonymized), and extended retention (90 days) for paid support tiers.
alex_prod: • Customers can choose: "Minimal (default)", "Assist (opt-in uploads)", or "Premium Observability" (paid, long retention, full traces).
chris_obs: We'll include a sampling config for high-throughput customers — default sample rate 0.1% for traces, adjustable per-route.
chris_obs: Example snippet for customer config (yaml):
chris_obs: ```
observability:
  mode: minimal # minimal | assist | premium
  trace_sample_rate: 0.001 # 0.1% default for premium/assist
  upload_consent: false
```
legal_priv: Legal notes: 1) telemetry is opt-out for metadata only; we treat payload uploads as opt-in. 2) For regulated customers, we require explicit contract addendum for any payload uploads or long-term retention. Route requests to legal@redwood.com.
emma_sales: Sales: need a short blurb — "Default collects only non-sensitive metrics; opt into assisted uploads for prioritized support and deeper diagnostics." Anyone object?
alex_prod: Fine by me. Add: assisted uploads are available only when customer executes the Observability Addendum (link in doc).
ops-bot: Internal policy created: OBS-PRIV-2026 assigned to chris_obs (due 2026-05-15).
tia_docs: Docs plan: publish internal FAQ + customer-facing migration guide by next Tue. We'll include sample consent language and the CLI toggles.
tia_docs: CLI example to enable assist uploads (customer must consent):
tia_docs: ```
redwoodctl observability set --mode assist --upload true --consent "diagnostics-for-support"
```
support_lead: Support note — Assist uploads enable faster RCA but will require a scoped support tunnel for air-gapped installations. We'll offer a one-time onboarding assist (paid) to ingest traces into our diagnostics UI. Sales ops, add SKU OBS-ONB-1 to templates.
emma_sales: Pricing question — is premium observability available for Self-Managed tier?
alex_prod: Premium is available only for SLA customers with dedicated contracts (due to storage and compliance needs). Self-Managed can opt into Assist but not Premium.
legal_priv: Also: retention limits tied to region/residency — customers in EU regions must select a retention policy <= 90 days unless we have explicit data residency agreement.
chris_obs: Implementation note for runtime: we'll redact model output tokens by default unless customer enables sample payload uploads. We will also support client-side masking rules to exclude PII before upload.
chris_obs: Action items: 1) SDK teams add client-side masking helpers (due 2026-05-01). 2) Ops provide support tunnel config snippet for air-gapped systems. 3) Docs publish migration FAQ.
tia_docs: Will include an example masking config in JS/Python.
tia_docs: JS example: ```
redwood.observability.configure({ mode: 'assist', maskRules: ['email','ssn'], consent: true })
```
support_lead: Outreach: we'll email all Private customers next week with the summary and opt-in steps. Customers that do nothing remain on Minimal and will continue to receive security fixes; diagnostics requiring uploads will need explicit consent.
emma_sales: Cool — I'll update the sales playbook and AE templates.
alex_prod: Thanks all. If there are no objections I'll publish the announcement and docs links today and ops will queue the migrations emails.
chris_obs: No objections from observability team. :thumbsup:
legal_priv: No objections from legal, just route deviations to legal@redwood.com.
ops-bot: Announcement published: <https://go.redwood/onprem-observability|onprem-observability> by @alex_prod at 4019876543
alex_prod: End of thread — appreciate the quick turn on this.
